last_change.instructions:
A caller is on the phone with the receptionist of Sage and Stone, a hair salon. Earlier in this call the salon booked an appointment for the caller, which they can still take back.

You classify the answer to a question. For each output field, choose exactly one class, using the class descriptions in the output schema. Judge only from the input. When the answer does not clearly fit a class, choose the class described for an unclear answer.

The input:
- `question`: What the person was last asked, word for word. Empty when nothing was asked.
- `answer`: What the person said back, as transcribed.
- `agreed`: What the person agreed to earlier, or was told had been done, which they could still take back.

anyOf.description: Keeps what is in `agreed`, or does not take it back. A "no" or "no, thanks" to a question that offers or asks about something else (other times, another service, anything else) declines that, and keeps `agreed`.

Takes back `agreed` itself: asks to undo or cancel it, says to leave it, or that they no longer want it. A condition on it is not taking it back. Asking for it on another day, at another time or as another service is `change`.
Wants what is in `agreed` done differently: another day, time or service. It is not undone.
Whether they take it back is unclear, or they put a condition on it ("only if...") that has not been answered yet.

anyOf.description: Ends the whole call with nothing left to ask: a goodbye, "that's all", or a "no" to "anything else?". Thanks on their own, or a yes to what was proposed, do not end it.

solver.instructions:
Read the caller utterance as exactly one decision about the pending proposal, using the class descriptions in the output schema. Accept only when delivered is true and the caller clearly approves that exact proposal. Use switch_task only for one of the listed destinations. Never invent digits.

You classify the answer to a question. For each output field, choose exactly one class, using the class descriptions in the output schema. Judge only from the input. When the answer does not clearly fit a class, choose the class described for an unclear answer.

The input:
- `question`: What the person was last asked, word for word. Empty when nothing was asked.
- `answer`: What the person said back, as transcribed.
- `step`: The part of the call the caller is in.
- `owner`: The caller's phone number, once they have given one. Empty before that.
- `proposal`: The proposal the salon put to the caller last. Null when there is none.
- `delivered`: Whether the caller heard the whole proposal before answering.
- `retained_complaint`: A complaint the caller already approved, kept while their number is checked. Null if none.
- `destinations`: The tasks the caller could switch to, and what each needs first.

Accept.description: Clearly approves the exact pending proposal, without conditions or questions.
Accept.title: Accept

ChooseAppointment.description: Chooses between moving the existing appointment and adding another. A bare yes cannot choose.
ChooseAppointment.title: ChooseAppointment

Clarify.description: The reply is ambiguous or incomplete in a way one short question would settle.

question.description: One short question to settle it. Never claim anything was done.
question.title: Question

Clarify.title: Clarify

Conditional.description: Agrees only under an additional condition.
Conditional.title: Conditional

CorrectPhone.description: Gives different digits for the number that was read back. Only for a phone readback.

digits.description: The whole corrected number in E.164, e.g. +34600111234. Keep the read-back digits the caller did not change. If you cannot tell which digits change, use clarify instead.
digits.title: Digits

CorrectPhone.title: CorrectPhone

EndCall.description: Ends the whole call with no remaining request.
EndCall.title: EndCall

NoDecision.description: Anything else: a question, small talk, or nothing that answers the pending proposal.
NoDecision.title: NoDecision

Reject.description: Declines the pending proposal and asks for nothing else.
Reject.title: Reject

Revise.description: Asks to change the pending proposal, for example another day or another outcome.
Revise.title: Revise

SalonSwitch.description: Abandons the current task, without finishing it, to do a different one of the listed destinations.

details.description: What the caller already said about the new task, in their words, so they are not asked again.
details.title: Details

SalonSwitch.title: SalonSwitch

output_schema.description: The caller's reply read as one decision, with a short reply only when switching task.

reply.description: Only for switch_task: one short sentence to the caller. Otherwise empty. Never claim anything was done.
reply.title: Reply

output_schema.title: SalonSolution

Asked.description:
A question this call put to the caller, and is waiting on the answer to.

Application-owned. A tool may propose the question; a separate classifier
interprets its answer, and the application checks the exact proposal.
The turn it was asked on is part of it, so an agreement two turns later is
not an answer to it.
Asked.title: Asked

Destination.description: A task the caller may switch to, and what it needs before it can start.
Destination.title: Destination

input_schema.description:
A snapshot of the reply and every application-owned fact needed to read it as one decision.

`delivered` is False when the caller spoke over the proposal, so it may be
corrected or abandoned but never accepted. Destinations are what the
caller could switch to; whether a switch is legal right now is checked
again when it is applied.
